statement: In the approval review gate, before publishing a new approval request, reset the shared result and clear the Event first. Publishing can synchronously deliver the answer, so clearing after publish loses that wakeup. Main UI writes result['decision'] before event.set(). The request(event,result,publish) path must wait for the event (not busy-wait) and only then return result['decision']; historical stale decisions must not survive into publish.

evidence.quote: Review gate race diagnosis: reset the shared result and clear the Event before publishing a new approval request. Publishing can synchronously deliver an answer; clearing after publish loses that wakeup. Main UI writes result['decision'] before event.set(). request(event,result,publish) must wait for the event, then return result['decision']. Never use busy waiting. Historical stale decisions must not survive into publish.

statement: The build dashboard uses midnight blue and pale green as presentation-only colors; they should not be used to convey semantic state.

evidence.quote: Build dashboard uses midnight blue and pale green; these are presentation-only colors.

statement: In this project, a separate archive utility maps document IDs to stable UUIDs and exports zip manifests; it is separate from the main codebase.

evidence.quote: A separate archive utility maps document IDs to stable UUIDs and exports zip manifests.

statement: In this project the image thumbnail job must preserve image aspect ratio and leave original photographs untouched; this applies only to that thumbnail job, not to all image handling.

evidence.quote: The image thumbnail job must preserve aspect ratio and leave original photographs untouched.

statement: In the billing reports subsystem, monetary amounts are grouped by currency and must never be added directly across different currencies; this rule applies to billing report aggregation, not necessarily to other currency handling.

evidence.quote: Billing reports group amounts by currency and never add different currencies directly.
